description.value: The Nicola Valley Community Arts Centre is a volunteer-powered, non-profit arts hub in downtown Merritt operated by the Nicola Valley Community Arts Council. It brings together a rotating art gallery with near-monthly exhibitions, an artisan gift shop, and artist studio and clubhouse spaces under one roof. Touring cyclists passing through the Nicola Valley will find a genuine community gathering place celebrating local visual arts, music, and performing arts.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at nicolavalleyarts.com successfully loaded and provides clear contact details: address 2051 Voght Street, Merritt, BC V1K 1B8 and phone 250-378-6515. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, showers, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all those fields are null. The blog shows posts as recent as April 2026, confirming the business is actively operating.
concerns: OSM name is 'Nicola Valley Community Arts Centre' but the website primarily refers to the physical space as 'Nicola Valley Arts Centre'; the 'Community Arts Council' is the operating organization. Minor naming conflation in OSM.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced entirely from the website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
Kekuli Cafe is described as an adjacent but separate business — it should not be credited as an on-site cafe amenity for this listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The arts centre is a legitimate, active cultural attraction in Merritt that could appeal to touring cyclists, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from website evidence — a site visit or direct contact would be needed to determine if it meets the minimum threshold for inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Address and phone sourced from website only (OSM fields were blank). No cycling amenities are mentioned on the website; a direct inquiry would be needed to confirm even basic facilities like washrooms and bike parking.
